limitations: Only two independent genuine 10-bit SDR families; minimum target 3 not reached.
No matched SDR/HDR pairs downloaded; LIVE requires access application with identity/affiliation details. No form submitted.
HEVC entries are explicitly local derivatives, not native external HEVC encodes.
10-bit source Y4M range unspecified; video range is an explicit derivative assumption.
Native camera/model and capture-session diversity cannot be fully established for stock footage; conservative creator grouping used.
External runtime validation covered 12 development sources and 4 validation sources; one validation source is metadata-only because its SMPTE 170M colorimetry is outside HDRCore's BT.709 SDR domain.
10-bit gradient-specific coverage remains incomplete; acquired 10-bit scenes are bar and outdoor narrator.
